name: SRF Ltd.
business_summary: Diversified chemicals-and-materials group: Chemicals (fluorospecialty, refrigerant gases, agrochem/pharma intermediates; the profit engine), Packaging Films (BOPET/BOPP), Technical Textiles (nylon tyre cord, belting fabrics) and others (laminated fabrics; Rs600 cr aluminium foil plant in MP announced 21 Oct). Q2 FY27: sales Rs4,904 cr, EBITDA Rs946 cr (19.3%), PAT Rs509 cr (+31% y/y). TTM sales Rs18,265 cr, PAT Rs2,283 cr. Mcap Rs73,570 cr, P/E 31.

exposures.mechanism: Exports ~35-40% of sales (fluorospecialty, agrochem intermediates, films; model knowledge), USD-linked inputs ~15% -> net long ~22% of sales; +3% -> +0.66% of sales -> EBITDA +3.4% at 19.3% OPM (946/4,904); 50% hedged -> +1.7; x EV/MCap 1.08 x persistence 0.5... ~+1; adds translation on overseas units -> +2.0. Empirical +1.79 (t +1.4) agrees.

Chloroform, fluorspar/HF, acetone, specialty feed ~30% of costs; +10% -> costs +3% = +2.4% of sales (costs ~80% of sales) -> EBITDA -12.4% at 19.3% OPM; ~60% passed through in 3-6m -> -5%; x1.08 x0.3... -1.6 -> -1.8.

evidence.note: Q2: PAT +31% to Rs509 cr, EBIT +26%, margin at eight-quarter low; miss driven by chemicals and non-fluoro businesses; Rs600 cr aluminium foil plant in MP; shares hit 52-wk low, Jefferies/MS/UBS cautious (NDTV Profit/BusinessLine/Zee)

exposures.mechanism: PTA/MEG for polyester films, nylon-6 chips and caprolactam for tyre cord are crude-derived: ~25% of costs in films and technical textiles (~45% of sales); +10% Brent -> feed +5% -> costs +1.1% of sales -> EBITDA -5.7%; 60% passed on -> -2.3 x1.08 x0.5... -1.2. No significant empirical Brent beta.

BOPET/BOPP film realisation spreads over PET/PP feed; +10% spreads on films ~25% of sales -> sales +2.5% x flow-through 80% = +2.0% of sales -> EBITDA +10% x1.08 x0.3 -> +3.2; shaded for oversupply from China/Vietnam.
SSU +10% global HFC/HFO refrigerant gas prices (quota-driven). Refrigerants ~15% of sales with 40% margins; +10% price -> +1.5% of sales -> EBITDA +7.8% x1.08 x0.5 -> +4.2; shaded.
Chinese pricing in agchem intermediates, PET film and refrigerants; +15% -> chemicals and films EBITDA -6% -> -2.5% equity. Q2 miss was in chemicals/non-fluoro (NDTV Profit headline).

evidence.note: Q2: PAT +31% to Rs509 cr, EBIT +26%, margin at eight-quarter low; miss driven by chemicals and non-fluoro businesses; Rs600 cr aluminium foil plant in MP; shares hit 52-wk low, Jefferies/MS/UBS cautious (NDTV Profit/BusinessLine/Zee)

exposures.mechanism: Fluorospecialty/agchem contract awards by innovators moving supply to India; supports chemicals growth and capex returns.
Nylon tyre cord (technical textiles ~15% of sales) follows tyre OEM/replacement volumes; +10% -> segment +8% -> +1.2% sales -> +1.0.
Net debt ~Rs6-7k cr (estimate; interest Rs267 cr TTM) from heavy capex; +25bp -> Rs15 cr = -0.7% PBT; P/E 31 duration -1.2 incl. RBI hike on 7 Oct.

evidence.note: RBI hiked repo 25bp to 5.50% on 7 Oct 2026, stance 'calibrated tightening' (Reuters/The Hindu/Moneycontrol headlines)

exposures.mechanism: Anti-dumping on PET film, nylon tyre cord fabric, R32/refrigerants protects realisations; +1 SSU -> +1% sales on 25% of portfolio -> +1.2.

supply_chain.counterparty: Agrochem and pharma innovators; refrigerant OEMs
